title: Original Dubrovin conjecture for Fano manifolds
exact_target: Does the original Dubrovin package connect semisimple quantum cohomology, full exceptional collections, and the specified Stokes and connection matrices for every Fano manifold?

sources.citation: S. Galkin, V. Golyshev and H. Iritani, Gamma classes and quantum cohomology of Fano manifolds: Gamma conjectures, arXiv:1404.6407v4, Section 4.6.
